notes.title: Dark Tower Update #1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28114284/cf5150e9aa6cb2c218d32fb0d51e042c8e13e93c.jpg
The following changes have been applied:

new app icon
improved main characters animation
added Immortal Queen and The Knight of the Tower Magic Nations cards (are acquired in-game notification/card activation code is accessible in the main menu)
fixed few spelling errors
floor level is displayed on the map
current floor level is visible in the teleportation window
added keyboard shortcuts: "M" - map, "T" - teleport, "C" - character, "B" - bestiary
removed some unnecessary dialogs
minor interface adjustments
minor bug fixes
